title: api-gateway: tune streaming proxy buffers, routing rules, and payload size limits for OpenAI-compatibility
author: Maya Thompson
description: Motivation: Several production customers and internal e2e tests surfaced intermittent streaming stalls and incorrect routing to legacy OpenAI-compat model variants when large tool-calling payloads are present. This PR applies three coordinated changes: 1) increase and make adaptive the streaming proxy buffer sizes to reduce backpressure stalls on long LLM streams; 2) tighten routing rules so that requests requiring OpenAI-compat behavior (function/tool calling + structured output) are pinned to the OpenAI-compat mux path and not routed to trimmed/quantized variants that drop compatibility guarantees; 3) add explicit payload size limits and graceful fallback behavior for function/tool-calling envelopes to avoid upstream service OOMs and improve error surfaces. Changes are conservative and gated behind feature flags; rollout plan described in release_notes. Checklist: - [x] Buffer tuning implemented with adaptive algorithm and safe defaults - [x] Routing policy additions with unit and integration tests - [x] Payload validation and graceful reject/fallback with clear error code - [x] E2E test to reproduce previously-observed stall - [x] Docs updated (openai_compat notes + migration tips) Rollout: staged canary to Dedicated -> Hosted GA with feature flag off by default for older tenants. See linked Linear tasks for rollout schedule and monitoring playbook.

Priya Nair (security): Confirmed payload validation avoids header smuggling and rejects N+1 nested function_call arrays. Requested test cases added.

Maya Thompson (author): Addressed all comments, added metrics (stream_buffer_resize_count, routing_fallback_count), and updated rollout plan to enable feature flag by canary only.
Alex Kim (approver): Approved after CI green and e2e pass.
release_notes:
- Improved streaming stability by making proxy buffer sizes adaptive and increasing safe defaults.
- Routing: requests requiring OpenAI-compat behavior (function/tool calling, structured output) are now pinned to the OpenAI-compat path to avoid incompatible model variants.
- Added payload size validation for function/tool-calling envelopes with graceful fallback and explicit error codes.
Rollout: feature-flagged; enable on canary Dedicated clusters first, validate metrics (stream_buffer_resize_count, routing_fallback_count), then enable for Hosted customers based on telemetry.
